purpose: Teach: せり/右下/団員/シャフト/本拠地/在り/ハイライト/ロケーション

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、市場の、本気で、絶対、せり、絶対、社会科見学で、絶対、行くんだよね
lines.en: Riku, you're definitely going to that fish market auction for the field trip, right? I mean, you have to.
lines.style: Bright, pressing curiosity. Leans forward slightly. Quick pace, eager. The tone of someone who already knows the answer but wants confirmation—and maybe wants him to be excited about it too.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。プリント、本気で、絶対、右下に、絶対、お前の、絶対、名前、絶対、書いてあったぜ、桜
lines.en: Yeah. It said so right there at the bottom of the handout—your name was on it, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet certainty. Low, steady voice. A small smile behind the words—catching her in her own obvious question. Calm, not teasing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 吹奏楽部の、本気で、絶対、団員、絶対、増えたよね、リク、お互いに、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: The brass band's getting bigger, isn't it? That's good. That's really good for both of us.
lines.style: Warmth bubbling through. Genuine happiness, not performed. Soft openings on each phrase. Tone rises slightly on the affirmation, then settles into sincerity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんから、本気で、絶対、ゴルフのシャフト、絶対、もらったんだぜ、桜、本気で、絶対、嬉しい
lines.en: Dad got me a new golf shaft. I'm pretty stoked about it, Sakura.
lines.style: Casual confidence with a thread of real gratitude underneath. Relaxed pace. The kind of pride that doesn't need much decoration—just stated plainly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちの本拠地、本気で、絶対、東京、絶対、なんだよ、リク、本気で、絶対、知ってた?本気で
lines.en: Did you know our team's based in Tokyo? Like, did that actually register for you?
lines.style: Playful challenge. Testing to see if he was paying attention. Quick delivery on the first part, then a slight drawl on the question—almost teasing but genuinely curious.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんの、本気で、絶対、在りし日の、絶対、お話、絶対、よく、絶対、聞いたぜ、桜、本気で、絶対、感謝
lines.en: I heard a lot of stories from my grandfather about the old days. I'm really grateful for that.
lines.style: Soft, reflective distance. Quiet respect woven through. Slow pace, lingering on the memory. Voice trails gently—not sad, just thoughtful, honoring something that matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今日の試合の、本気で、絶対、ハイライト、絶対、お前のシュート、絶対、だったよね、リク
lines.en: Your shot today—that was the highlight of the whole match, wasn't it?
lines.style: Genuine admiration, no flattery. Direct eye contact in the voice. Steady pace. The kind of praise that lands because it's specific and real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行の、本気で、絶対、ロケーション、絶対、楽しみだよな、桜
lines.en: I'm really looking forward to where we're going for the school trip.
lines.style: Eager anticipation with an undertone of contentment. Slight rise on the opening. Warm, conversational—like sharing something good with someone you trust.
